integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically. Exhaustive enumeration through order nine is only a stress test. Prior exact boundary cases were checked against full accessible source text.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs and the connected dom-k-forcing rule. It does not classify all minimum sets or propagation times. Literature noncoverage remains subject to terminology risk.
title: Connected dom-k-forcing of complete multipartite graphs
